segments.an5.37:1.1: “Bhojanaṃ, bhikkhave, dadamāno dāyako paṭiggāhakānaṃ pañca ṭhānāni deti.
segments.an5.37:1.3: Āyuṃ deti, vaṇṇaṃ deti, sukhaṃ deti, balaṃ deti, paṭibhānaṃ [paṭibhāṇaṃ (sī.)] deti.
segments.an5.37:1.4: Āyuṃ kho pana datvā āyussa bhāgī hoti dibbassa vā mānusassa vā;
segments.an5.37:1.5: vaṇṇaṃ datvā vaṇṇassa bhāgī hoti dibbassa vā mānusassa vā;
segments.an5.37:1.6: sukhaṃ datvā sukhassa bhāgī hoti dibbassa vā mānusassa vā;
segments.an5.37:1.7: balaṃ datvā balassa bhāgī hoti dibbassa vā mānusassa vā;
segments.an5.37:1.8: paṭibhānaṃ datvā paṭibhānassa bhāgī hoti dibbassa vā mānusassa vā.
segments.an5.37:1.9: Bhojanaṃ, bhikkhave, dadamāno dāyako paṭiggāhakānaṃ imāni pañca ṭhānāni detī”ti.
segments.an5.37:3.2: sukhañca paṭibhānakaṃ [paṭibhāṇakaṃ (sī.), paṭibhānado (syā. kaṃ. pī. ka.)];

lines: Bhāsitaññūti bhikkhū gharadvāre ṭhitā kiñcāpi tuṇhī honti, atthato pana “bhikkhaṃ dethā”ti vadanti nāma ariyāya yācanāya.
Vuttañhetaṃ “uddhissa ariyā tiṭṭhanti, esā ariyānaṃ yācanā”ti.
Tatra ye “mayaṃ pacāma, ime na pacanti, pacamāne patvā alabhantā kuhiṃ labhissantī”ti deyyadhammaṃ saṃvibhajanti, te bhāsitaññū nāma ñatvā kattabbassa karaṇato.
